## TRA Timeline

#### Form-of TRA on the SPAC's CIK

- 2022-07-12: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit D embedded in the original Agreement and Plan of Merger, Exhibit 2.1 to the 8-K
- 2023-09-15: Same form-of TRA re-filed as Annex F to the DEFM14A proxy statement / prospectus
- 2023-09-26: FAST II stockholder vote approving the business combination

#### Business combination close (TRA migrates to PubCo CIK)

- 2023-10-06: Business combination closes; executed TRA is filed under Falcon's Beyond Global, Inc.'s CIK 0001937987
- 2023-10-05: FAST II files Form 25 (delisting)
- 2023-10-17: FAST II files Form 15-12G (deregistration)

## Explanation

FAST Acquisition Corp. II was a SPAC that, by stockholder vote on September 26, 2023, entered into an Up-C business combination with Falcon's Beyond Global, LLC. Under the deal structure, FAST II merged into Falcon's Beyond Global, Inc. (the PubCo and TRA obligor), and the LLC's pre-business-combination members became the Exchange TRA Holders. Only the unexecuted form-of TRA (preamble date and signatures blank) appears under FAST II's CIK, attached to the original merger agreement and to the definitive proxy as a beneficiary protection. FAST II's last filing was the September 26, 2023 stockholder-vote 8-K; the executed TRA and all subsequent disclosures live under the successor PubCo's CIK 0001937987. See `../falcon-s-beyond-global-inc_0001937987/falcon-s-beyond-global-inc_summary.qmd` for the executed contract's life and `contract_log.md` here for the form-of provenance.
